meta.description: Coverage ledger v2: exploration heat and verification strength are separate dimensions. Verification is human-authored evidence-based confidence. Exploration is machine-measured telemetry reach.

squad-submission.name: Squad Submission
squad-submission.notes: Harnesses start post-squad. Modal handler (squad_modal_) never exercised headlessly.

map-selection.name: Map Selection
map-selection.notes: 8 handlers (map_selection_, map_type_, map_confirm_, etc.) never exercised. Harnesses skip to post-map.

initiative.name: Initiative Determination
initiative.notes: determine_initiative_ handler never exercised. Includes Devious Scheme CC branch.

zone-selection.name: Zone Selection
zone-selection.notes: Real handleDeploymentZone exercised. Always picks red — blue never tested. 2000/2000 pass. Production fix: getFootprintCells wrapper.

attachment-placement.name: Attachment Placement
attachment-placement.notes: Setup harness handles auto-attached armies and attach_done_confirm. Manual attachment (setup_attach_to_, attach_confirm_, attach_reselect_) never exercised. Restriction parsing untested. Only auto-attach path, no manual path.
liveIncidents: Attachment ordering bugs reported in live games

auto-deploy.name: Auto Deploy
auto-deploy.notes: Real handleAutoDeploy exercised with 171 DCs across 6 maps. Large figures (1x2, 2x3) covered after getFootprintCells fix. 2000/2000 pass.

manual-deployment.name: Manual Deployment
manual-deployment.notes: deployment_fig_, deploy_pick_, deploy_row_, deployment_orient_ never exercised. Includes loadout_pick_ (Purge Trooper) and form_pick_ (Clawdite Shapeshifter).

companion-deployment.name: Companion Deployment
companion-deployment.notes: Post-deploy companion placement (e.g., The Child via Clan of Two) fires inside runPostDeployPhase but interactive buttons unhandled by harness.

post-deploy-abilities.name: Post-Deploy Abilities
post-deploy-abilities.notes: 15 interactive post-deploy handlers (Cassian Strike Team, Bodhi Smooth Landing, Ko-Tun Arms Distribution, Scavenged Walker, Extra Armor, Security Detail, Forward Emplacement, Infiltration). All dark.

cc-draw.name: CC Draw
cc-draw.notes: Real handleCcShuffleDraw + handleIKnowEverythingKeep (Moff Gideon). Shuffle, draw 3, channel validation all covered. 2000/2000 pass.

activate-dc.name: DC Activation
activate-dc.notes: Flow harness exercises dc_activate via available-actions. Starts from synthetic ROUND_ACTIVE. GS-1/GS-2 invariants verify state consistency. 99% pass rate.

movement.name: Movement
movement.notes: Flow harness exercises dc_move, move_mp, move_pick. Synthetic start positions. Grid/adjacency logic exercised but not from real deployment positions.

attack-declaration.name: Attack Declaration
attack-declaration.notes: Flow harness exercises dc_attack with random target selection via available-actions. Synthetic positions mean range/LOS not fully realistic.

combat-lifecycle.name: Combat Lifecycle
combat-lifecycle.notes: Flow harness covers combat_ready -> combat_roll -> surge -> resolve chain. Dice rolling, damage calculation, defeat handling exercised. GS-3/GS-4 verify HP/damage consistency. Some DC-specific combat effects may be missed.

surge-spending.name: Surge Spending
surge-spending.notes: Flow harness exercises combat_surge (aggressive policy prefers it). Skip surges also exercised. Not all surge ability combinations tested.

reroll.name: Reroll
reroll.notes: Flow harness can hit combat_reroll but it's rare — requires specific DC abilities or CC cards. Low hit count in sims. No targeted test.

negation.name: Negation
negation.notes: Flow harness has negation action type but Negation CC rarely appears in random hands. No targeted test forces Negation into hand. Handler path exists but verification is opportunistic not deliberate.

celebration.name: Celebration
celebration.notes: Flow harness exercises celebration_play/pass via cc-eager policy but celebration is rarely triggered (requires killing a unique figure). Verification is incidental not deliberate.

strain-choice.name: Strain Choice
strain-choice.notes: Triggered when a figure takes strain damage. Appears in sims but rarely. No targeted test.

conditions.name: Conditions (Bleed/Stun/Weaken)
conditions.notes: Conditions applied via surge abilities during combat. sendBleedingPrompt stub missing in flow harness causes recurring handler errors. Verification is incidental.
liveIncidents: sendBleedingPrompt is not a function — recurring handler error in flow sims

token-overflow.name: Token Overflow
token-overflow.notes: Triggered when a figure exceeds token limits. Very rare in sims. Handler chain exercised opportunistically.

push-pull.name: Push / Pull / Displacement
push-pull.notes: Push/pull effects (Slam, Force Push, Pounce, Cover Fire, Spread Pain). Flow harness hits pounce_space/cover_fire via DC abilities but no targeted verification.

end-activation.name: End Activation / Turn Switch
end-activation.notes: Flow harness exercises dc_end_activation and pass_activation_turn. GS-5 verifies activation count consistency. Turn alternation logic exercised.

round-transition.name: Round Transition
round-transition.notes: Flow harness reaches end-of-round and start-of-round when all DCs activate. GS-6/GS-7 verify round state. Not all SOR/EOR ability effects exercised.

phase-gates.name: Phase Gates
phase-gates.notes: Both harnesses exercise phase_gate_ready for deploy_done, cc_drawn, pre_activation, post_start_of_round gates. Real handler chain. Dual-player ready logic verified.

forfeit-game-over.name: Forfeit / Game Over
forfeit-game-over.notes: forfeit_, forfeit_yes_, kill_game_ handlers never exercised. Game-over via VP/defeat check fires in flow harness when games complete (~5%) but forfeit path is dark.

hand-private-surfaces.name: Hand / Private Surfaces
hand-private-surfaces.notes: DS-1 invariant verifies CC hand cards don't leak to shared surface. DS-2/DS-3 track surface model consistency. But actual Discord thread routing, private followUp delivery, and discard thread behavior are not verified — only the data model is checked, not the Discord API calls.

wrong-player-routing.name: Wrong-Player Routing
wrong-player-routing.notes: DS-5 invariant checks that actions don't appear in wrong player's available-actions surface. Detects some routing bugs but not all (e.g., followUp sent to wrong channel).

hidden-info-leak.name: Hidden Info Leak Prevention
hidden-info-leak.notes: DS-1 invariant checks CC hand cards don't leak to shared surface. Found 1 real leak in 500 flow sims (seed=493, Take Cover via dc_special). That leak is a verified detection — DS-1 caught a real bug.
liveIncidents: DS-1 violation: Take Cover leaked via dc_special followUp

stale-component.name: Stale Component Cleanup
stale-component.notes: DS-7 checks for cleanup after state transitions. DS-9 checks for stale buttons remaining after phase changes. Invariants fire on the surface model, not actual Discord messages. Partial structural verification.

payload-shape.name: Payload Shape Limits
payload-shape.notes: DS-8 checks select menu options <= 25. DS-10 validates component structure. These fire every step of every flow sim. Structural verification against Discord API limits.

timing-concurrency.name: Timing / Concurrency
timing-concurrency.notes: Race conditions from concurrent button clicks. async-mutex used in production. Not testable in headless (single-threaded sequential dispatch).
